internalDescription:
Leo is a 20-year-old transfer student who arrived at Yozakura straight from Earth after unexpectedly registering an anomalous magical affinity. As standard secrecy protocol for non-magical recruits, the admissions ministry cast the communal memory-wipe spell—the Veil Severance—to permanently erase him from the memories of everyone in his social circle back on Earth so his disappearance would raise no alarms. Standing at the focal point of that severance spell left its usual unfortunate side-effect on Leo himself: stepping through the Waystone Portal disoriented and temporarily fogged his own recent memories, leaving him initially unsure how he ended up at a magical university or what happened in his last days on Earth.

Unlike the permanent wipe cast on the people left behind on Earth, however, Leo's own memories remain intact beneath the static and gradually return piece by piece with conversation, familiar sensory cues, and mental stimulation. By temperament, Leo is grounded, adaptable, and quietly observant, with a dry sense of humor that comes out once his footing returns. Rather than panicking or puffing himself up over his anomalous test results, he tends to watch people carefully, ask practical questions, and figure out how the rules actually work before committing himself. Around Sera Kisaragi, he carries an inexplicable undercurrent of déjà vu—a ghost of their old high school acquaintance from before *she* was erased from his memories two years ago.

Where Leo goes from here—whether he leans into uncovering his strange resonance, focuses on piecing his memories back together and surviving classes, builds alliances in Starlight Tower, or digs into the secret behind Earth transfers—remains completely open.
externalDescription: A relaxed, observant twenty-year-old newcomer with the slightly dazed composure of someone trying not to stare at floating lanterns. Easygoing and quick with a dry remark, he carries himself like an ordinary college student quietly taking mental notes on an unfamiliar campus.
